portal.docs.mustRead.title: Must read!!! Must read!!! Must read!!!
portal.docs.mustRead.lead: Read this page first to avoid most connection issues.
portal.docs.mustRead.p1: Use only the clients recommended in these docs. Other clients may fail to parse the subscription or connect.
portal.docs.mustRead.p2: Do not share your subscription URL. If it leaks, reset it in your profile immediately.
portal.docs.mustRead.p3: Use Clash Verge Rev on Windows/macOS, Shadowrocket on iOS, and Clash Meta for Android on Android.

portal.docs.support.title: Submit a ticket if you need help

portal.docs.windows.title: Windows tutorial
portal.docs.windows.lead: Please update Clash Verge Rev to the latest version to keep the service working.
portal.docs.windows.downloadX64: Download Clash Verge Rev v2.4.7 (64-bit, recommended)
portal.docs.windows.downloadArm64: Download Clash Verge Rev v2.4.7 (ARM64, uncommon)
portal.docs.windows.note: For a better experience, use Clash Verge Rev. v2rayN may have compatibility issues.
portal.docs.windows.step2Body: Double-click the installer and click Next until it finishes. Depending on your device, the progress bar may appear stuck for about 5 minutes.
portal.docs.windows.step3Body: Go back to the dashboard, click One-click subscribe, then copy the subscription URL.
portal.docs.windows.step4Body: In the client, click Profiles on the left, paste the URL into the input box, and click Import.
portal.docs.windows.step5Body: Click Proxies on the left and select a node from the list.
portal.docs.windows.step6Body: Click Settings on the left, find System Proxy, and turn it on.
portal.docs.macos.title: macOS tutorial
portal.docs.macos.lead: Please update Clash Verge Rev to the latest version to keep the service working.
portal.docs.macos.downloadArm: Download Clash Verge Rev v2.4.7 (Apple silicon)
portal.docs.macos.step2Body: Open the downloaded package and drag Clash Verge Rev into Applications. If macOS shows a security prompt, open Finder → Applications and click Open. After launch, a cat icon appears in the menu bar.
portal.docs.macos.step3Body: Go back to the dashboard, click One-click subscribe, then Import to Clash. You can also copy the subscription URL and import it in the client.
portal.docs.macos.step4Body: Click the Clash icon in the menu bar and select a node from the list.
portal.docs.macos.step5Body: Click the Clash icon and enable Set as system proxy.
portal.docs.ios.title: iOS tutorial
portal.docs.ios.lead: Please update Shadowrocket to the latest version to keep the service working.
portal.docs.ios.note: For a better experience, use Shadowrocket. Quantumult X may have compatibility issues.
portal.docs.ios.step2Body: On the dashboard, choose Import to Shadowrocket to open the app and import automatically. If iOS asks to add a VPN configuration, tap Allow, select any node, then turn on the switch at the top.
portal.docs.android.title: Android tutorial
portal.docs.android.lead: Please update Clash Meta for Android to the latest version to keep the service working.
portal.docs.android.downloadBtn: Download Clash Meta for Android v2.11.26
portal.docs.android.note: For a better experience, use Clash Meta for Android. v2rayNG may have compatibility issues.
portal.docs.android.step2Body: After the download finishes, open the notification and tap Install. If there is no notification, find the APK in Downloads or your browser and install it.
portal.docs.android.step3Body: Go back to the dashboard, click One-click subscribe, then copy the subscription URL.
portal.docs.android.step4Body: Open the client, tap Config, then +, then Import from URL. Paste the subscription URL into Config URL, tap Confirm, then Save.
portal.docs.android.step5Body: Go back to the home screen, tap Proxy, and select any node.
portal.docs.android.step6Body: Go back to the home screen and tap Stopped. When the network connection request appears, tap OK. You can then use the Running switch to turn the connection on or off.
